text:
jane-cs: Heads-up — multiple CS tickets about 502/504s and auth timeouts for hosted inference in eu-west2 AZ3. Customer reports began ~07:10 UTC, spike in 5xx and connection timeouts. Metrics: 5xx rate ~2.3% (baseline 0.03%), median p95 latency up from 220ms to 1200ms.

tom-network: looking. Any BGP flaps or carrier notices?

deploy-bot: [alert] gateway-eu-west2-AZ3: spike_5xx=+210/min, auth_timeouts=+95/min, trace_id_bucket=eu-west2-az3. See dashboard: https://dash.redwood/internal/incidents/7924681234

jane-cs: customers seeing repeated retries -> token expiry errors too (401s) — sequence: generate request -> gateway 502 -> client retries -> auth token consumed -> subsequent 401. Need quick mitigation for high-volume customers.

david_sre: can someone post interface counters + netstat from the edge nodes? I want to check retransmits and queued drops.

tom-network: quick snapshot from edge-az3-01: 
```
eth2: rx_errors=312 rx_dropped=89 tx_errors=0 tx_dropped=2
ifconfig eth2: txqueuelen=1000
/sbin/ip -s -s neigh show dev eth2 | tail -n +1
```
Looks like rx errors concentrated on eth2 path out to transit ASN 64512.

maria.ops: CS playbook triggered. I'm routing high-urgency customers to eu-west1 as temporary workaround. Can eng-infra confirm cross-region fallback policy?

eng-infra: can confirm automatic fallback exists but we need to update policy to include session-affinity drop. Executing canary reroute for 10% traffic now.

jane-cs: thanks — telling customers about in-progress failover and ETA ~15m. Also logging which tenants hit token spikes for billing follow-up.

support-bot: Dashboard snapshot: top error code 502 (gateway timeout). Top source ASNs: [64512, 33333]. Top affected prefixes: 203.0.113.0/24. Correlation: increase in TCP retransmits at ~07:05 UTC.

david_sre: request: get tcpdump from edge-az3-01 for 10s on port 443 to correlate with provider ASN. Command: 
```
sudo tcpdump -i eth2 -w /tmp/az3-edge-443.pcap 'tcp port 443' -c 10000
```
I'll pull and inspect for dup/ack patterns.

tom-network: provider show: BGP updates flapped for neighbor 198.51.100.2 around 07:04 UTC, lots of path changes -> likely ECMP asymmetry + packet loss on one leg. Opening ticket with provider ASN 64512 now.

eng-infra: temporary mitigation applied: set BGP community to prefer backup path for the affected prefixes and increased retries for the gateway health check. Canary reroute looks healthy so far for 10% — 200s increased to 0.1% in canary. Scaling to 40% now.

maria.ops: customers on the failover path reporting recovered requests, but two high-volume tenants still seeing intermittent 502s — looks correlated to their retries exhausting token window.

bill-ops: flagging possible billing anomaly: retry storms may create inflated metered usage for affected customers. Let's mark impacted tenants for invoice credit review.

jane-cs: repro steps collected from customer "AcmeRetail":
1) curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' 
2) response: HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
3) repeat x3 -> 401/invalid_token on 4th attempt

They provided logs showing back-to-back timestamps (07:05:12 -> 07:05:17 -> 07:05:21).

david_sre: analysis: packet loss + ECMP reorders cause gateway connections to stall; client retries amplify concurrency and some auth tokens are being dropped due to short-lived sessions. Short-term: increase auth token grace window by +30s and throttle client retries at gateway. Long-term: provider escalation + adjust ECMP hashing and add selective blackholing of bad path.

tom-network: provider ticket opened: TKT-64512-2983. Carrier response: investigating underlying link flaps, will update in 30m.

eng-infra: runbook steps executed:
- canary reroute to eu-west1 applied
- increased gateway retry-backoff to 500ms -> 2s
- auth grace window bumped (temporary flag)
- monitoring alert thresholds lowered to detect retransmit spikes earlier

maria.ops: CS status update sent to customers: we've applied cross-region failover and temporary auth grace; provider is investigating. ETA next update 07:50 UTC. :white_check_mark:

jane-cs: next steps/owner list:
- tom-network: escalate with provider + confirm physical link (owner)
- david_sre: analyze pcap and post root cause indicators (RCEGs)
- eng-infra: keep rolling out reroute if stable, revert auth grace after fix
- bill-ops: tag impacted tenants for credits
- maria.ops: keep customers updated every 30m

jane-cs: saving logs/pcaps under /incidents/7924681234/ and will start RCA doc after provider response. Closing triage for now but keeping channel open for updates. :lock:
